title: Chai Ki Tapri Pe Pyaar
synopsis: Chhavi, 22, runs her late mother's blue-canopy stall with her father Shankar. Across the lane, Lalan's red-canopy stall has been Shankar's enemy for years. Lalan's son Veer returns from the city, and when the town announces that only one stall will survive after the annual fair, the two must compete, and slowly fall for each other.
content_advisory: family quarrels and heartbreak, no violence, no strong language
ai_disclosure_note: Story and dialogue written with AI assistance; images, motion, voices and music generated with AI tools.

episodes.title: Do Tapri, Ek Gali
episodes.description: Veer comes home to the lane, collides with Chhavi, and the town announces only one stall will survive.

episodes.title: Baarish Wali Chai
episodes.description: Rain wrecks both stalls and Chhavi helps her enemy, and then both fathers catch them together.

episodes.title: Galat Fehmi
episodes.description: A rooftop evening of confessions ends when Chhavi sees Veer with a man who wants to buy the lane.

episodes.title: Mele Ki Raat
episodes.description: At the fair, rivalry turns to worry for Lalan, and the lane's new owner is announced.

episodes.title: Chai Ka Teesra Pyaala
episodes.description: The truth about the lane, two fathers share one cup, and an old photo opens a new secret.
